Definition: glaring, i.e. exposed to the bright sun
BiblicalUsage: tsᵉchîyach means glaring, i.e. exposed to the bright sun. It appears 5 times in Scripture, including Ezekiel 24:7 and Ezekiel 26:4.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe tsᵉchîyach shows how carefully God chose His words, and this one earns its place.
